pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

2. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

3. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

10. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Verse and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — The speed of the music

10. C — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Red, blue, and yellow

12. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

16. (4 marks)
